title: Revoking a counter scanner or a member card asks first, because a revoked one is retired for good
detail: Meta scan 2026-10-20 of the work merged since 2026-10-19 (LIVE-1125). components/spaces/loyalty/scanner-panel.tsx revoked a scanner or a member card on one click. The runbook says a revoked scanner is retired for good, and a revoked scanner stops every counter that holds its key, so a stray tap on the list takes a Space's check-ins offline. Destructive buttons elsewhere ask first (components/ui/confirm-submit-button.tsx).

verify.note: Fails when revoke() starts the server action without asking the owner to confirm first.
